description: Seed-pinned case sets checked by npm run benchmark against benchmarks/answer-key-<id>.json. The first set is the benchmark's own population (unchanged); the keys apply only to a run with its parameters.

sets.description: The existing benchmark's population: 2,000 blended cases plus 150 per stratum, from distribution_config.json with no profile applied. Decision: the underwriting policy (scoreCase). Flagged: any fraud rule fired.
Solar prime: 2,000 blended cases (the test:credit sample) plus 40 per stratum. Decision: the credit policy (assessCredit). Flagged: sent to fraud review (a HIGH-severity rule fired).
